messages:
benji: quick sync — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9876 is green but blocked by arch sign-off. RFC https://redwood.inference/rfcs/783-lite-routing added yesterday. Can someone from arch skim today? :pray:

maria: taking a look now, pinging @arch-team. ETA 2h.

sam: left a quick comment on the PR about shard affinity tests failing in CI — small fix, but need canary plan before merge.

benji: thanks. canary plan in PR description: ```canary: 10% traffic / 1h``` Also note rollout should fallback to model-variant v2 on error.

arch-bot: New RFC review request created: https://redwood.inference/rfcs/783-lite-routing — reviewers: @maria @henry

henry: skimmed — looks safe for lightweight blessing. a couple nits on compatibility matrix, but nothing blocking. If ops fine with canary + fallback, I can LGTM.

sam: ops — can you confirm canary schedule slot today at 16:00 UTC? If yes, tag `ready-to-merge` on PR.

ops: we have a slot at 16:00 UTC, but need a deploy playbook note. added one to PR.

benji: awesome. henry please drop an explicit arch OK in thread and i'll merge after canary.

henry: arch OK from me. :white_check_mark: merge after canary completes.

benji: thanks all — will monitor post-merge metrics and ping if anything flakey.
